scope: Proposition 2.1 (Transverse rigidity) of the manuscript “Weak mixing of triangular billiards with an irrational angle” (preprints/Weak-mixing-of-triangular-billiards-with-an-irrational-angle-October-5-2026/weak-mixing-triangular-billiards.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 150 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2d03664d20b89a52), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let M be the regular oriented double of a fixed nondegenerate Euclidean triangle, and let Ψt be its geodesic flow on SM with normalized Liouville measure. Suppose λ ∈ R and f ∈ L∞(SM) satisfy f ◦ Ψt = eiλt f in L2 (SM) for every t ∈ R. Then f has square-integrable horizontal weak derivatives and Y f = 0, Xf = iλf, ∥∇f∥2 2 = λ2 ∥f∥2 2 .
